text.p: These are the leading stories in the Lebanese press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A guerrilla was killed as his group clashed with Israeli soldiers advancing north of Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone.
- Schoolteachers on one-day strike next Wednesday.
- Lebanon beat Singapore 2-1 in their World Cup Asian zone group seven qualifiying match.
- Opposition members of parliament heavily coordinate positions ahead of upcoming general assembly.
- Hizbollah secretary general Nasrallah: Protecting the resistance is the most important of duties.
- Human rights activist Lore Mogheizel died in Beirut.
- Hariri to Damascus after listening to Maronite Patriarch Sfeir.
